title: Annual influenza vaccination, children 6 months-8 years (at least 1 dose per year)

source.quote:
Use any influenza vaccine appropriate for age and health 
status annually:

action: Administer at least one age-appropriate influenza vaccine dose each year. Children with fewer than 2 prior doses need 2 doses, but that part is not encoded.

derived.min: minimum age is 6 months, which cannot be expressed in whole years; age >=1 at year end is used so every included child was eligible during the year (infants 6-11 months are omitted)

derived.min_count: every child in this age band needs at least 1 dose per year (1 or 2 depending on prior history), so 1 is the minimum expected count
